name: Sleep chart
summary: Last night's sleep as a hypnogram of awake, REM, light and deep sleep across the night, the time and share spent in each stage, and the last seven nights as bars against a goal line.
use: in a sleep, health or wearable app, for the morning summary of last night
a11y: The hypnogram is one image with a written summary of the night; stage totals are a description list and each night's bar carries its date and hours as text for screen readers.
